The layout: the front carries the tagline, the roaring leopard and the tournament name. The back is the panther emerging from the dark, with the Pianos Plus wordmark along the bottom. Each sleeve carries a logo: Mount Pleasant Juniors Squash on one, Quilter Cheviot on the other.

The look: every element sits on transparency, so the black drops into the fabric — no white boxes anywhere. The Juniors Squash crest keeps its blue and yellow; Quilter Cheviot is reversed to white with its gold accent. The leopard is enhanced for a large front print; the panther is your original image.
